record.paper_title: Some Open Problems and Conjectures on Submanifolds of Finite Type: Recent Development
record.original_question: Study and classify submanifolds of codimension 2 in Euclidean space whose immersion is linearly independent, meaning that when the position vector field is written in its finite spectral decomposition x = c + x₁ + ··· + x_k, the subspaces E_i spanned by {x_i(p) : p ∈ M} are linearly independent.

evidence.quote: Suppose that x : M → E^m is a k-type immersion whose spectral decomposition is given by (2.1). Denote by Ei the subspace of E^m spanned by {xi(p), p ∈ M}, i ∈ {1,...,k}. The immersion x (or the submanifold M) is called linearly independent if the subspaces E1,...,Ek are linearly independent.
Problem 8. Study and classify linearly independent submanifolds of codimension 2.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $x : M \to \mathbb{E}^m$ be an isometric immersion of a connected Riemannian manifold $M$ into Euclidean $m$-space. Assume that $x$ is of finite type, so that the position vector field admits a finite spectral decomposition
$$x = c + x_1 + x_2 + \cdots + x_k,$$
where $c \in \mathbb{E}^m$ is a constant vector and each non-constant $\mathbb{E}^m$-valued map $x_i$ on $M$ satisfies $\Delta x_i = \lambda_i x_i$ for pairwise distinct eigenvalues $\lambda_1, \dots, \lambda_k$ of the Laplacian acting componentwise. For each $i \in \{1, \dots, k\}$, let
$$E_i = \mathrm{span}\{ x_i(p) : p \in M \} \subset \mathbb{E}^m.$$
The immersion $x$ (equivalently, the submanifold $M$) is said to be linearly independent if the subspaces $E_1, \dots, E_k$ are linearly independent in $\mathbb{E}^m$ (i.e., the sum $E_1 + \cdots + E_k$ is direct).

Problem: Study and completely classify all linearly independent finite-type submanifolds of codimension $2$ in Euclidean space, i.e., the case $\dim M = m - 2$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as a classification problem on linearly independent finite-type submanifolds of codimension 2. Partial results exist (work by Jang and others on linearly independent immersions of codimension ≤ 3, and conditions equating linear independence with orthogonality in low codimension), but no complete classification in codimension 2 appears in the literature accessible via search. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems and conjectures on submanifolds of finite type: recent development
status_evidence.snippet: Lists Problem 8: study and classify linearly independent submanifolds of codimension 2.
status_evidence.claim: The classification of linearly independent codimension-2 submanifolds is stated as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Tamkang Journal of Mathematics, Vol. 45 (2014), 87-108
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses linearly independent immersions and notes only partial results in low codimension (Jang and others).
status_evidence.claim: Only partial results in codimension ≤ 3 are reported; no full classification in codimension 2.
